results.title: An ɗage taron ƙungiyar OIF bayan saɓani ya kunno kai a tsakanin mambobinta
results.content: Ƙungiyar ƙasashe masu amfani da harshen Faransanci OIF, ta ɗage zaɓen sabon wanda zai shugabance ta da shekara guda bayan saɓani ya kunno kai a tsakanin mambobinta.

results.title: Kurdawa na samun nasara a kan mayakan ISIS a Syria
results.content: Dubban yan gudun hijira na ci gaba da tserewa fadan da ake tabkawa tsakanin Kurdawa da mayakan Jihadin kungiyar Isis a kasar Syriya al'amarin da ya haifar da kwararar 'yan gudun hijira a kasar Turkiya.

results.title: An samu raguwar kona motoci a bikin sabuwar shekara a Faransa
results.content: Gwamnatin Faransa tace an samu raguwar yawan adadin motocin da ake konewa a lokacin bikin sabuwar shekara da kashi 12 cikin 100 a cikin kasar. alkalumma sun nuna cewa a jajibirin sabuwar shekara an kone motoci 940 sabanin 1,067, da aka cinna wa wuta a shekarar da ta gabata.

results.title: Gwamnatin Birtaniya tayi afuwa ga matan da aka kama kan laifin zubar da ciki
results.content: Gwamnatin Burtaniya ta yafewa matan da aka kama tare da gurfanar da su a gaban kotu bisa laifin zubar da juna biyu, ƙarƙashin sabuwar dokar Victorian-era, wadda ta amince da yafiya.

results.title: Kotun Duniya ta bukaci Afirka ta Kudu ta cafke El-Bashir
results.content: Kotun hukunta manyan laifufuka a duniya ICC ko kuma CPI ta bukaci hukumomin kasar Afirka ta kudu da su kama shugaban Sudan Umar Hasan El-bashir wanda ke halarar taron shugabannin Afirka yanzu haka a birnin Johannesburg.

results.title: An cafke mutane da dama kan zargin juyin mulki a Gambia
results.content: An cafke mutane da dama, da ake zargi suna da hannu a yunkurin jurin juyin mulkin da aka yi a kasar Gambia, lokacin da shugaban kasa Yahya Jammeh ke ziyara a birnin Dubai, wanda kuma ya dora alhakin harin kan ‘yan kasashen waje da bai bayyana sunayen su ba.

results.title: Shugaba Jose ya lashe zaɓen Cape Verde a karo na biyu
results.content: Shugaba Jose Maria Neves na Cape Verde, ya sake lashe zaben shugabancin ƙasar a karo na biyu, wanda zai bashi damar ci gaba da mulkin ƙasar har na tsawon shekaru biyar masu zuwa.

results.title: Ambaliyar Ruwan sama ta yi sanadiyar mutuwar mutane 12 a Jojiya
results.content: yanzu haka dai masu kula da namun daji na ci gaba da farautar namun daji a tsakkiyar birnin Tbilissi na kasar Jojiya, bayan da ambaliyar Ruwan sama da aka sheka a birnin ta rusa gidan namun dajin da a halin yanzu suka fantsama a cikin gari

results.title: Ana ci gaba da aikin neman tarkacen jirgin AirAsia
results.content: Yau Juma’a masu aiki neman sassan jirgin saman da ya yi hadari a kan tekun Java na kasar Indonesia, sun ci gaba da aikin, kuma suna gab da kaiwa inda lamarin ya faru. An dakatar da aikin neman Jirgin ne saboda matsalar Yanayi a tekun Indonesia

results.title: Burkina Faso ta ƙarbi ƴan kasarta dubu 45 da aka kora daga Guinea
results.content: Hukumar bayar da agaji ta Burkina Faso CONASUR ta ce aƙalla masu haƙar ma’adinai dubu 45,000 ciki har da ƙananan yara da kuma mutanen da ba ƴan asalin Ougadougou bane suka shigo ƙasar bayan korar su daga Guinea Conakry

results.title: Taron Kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25
results.content: A yau lahadi ake buda taron shugabannin kasashen kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25 a birnin Jonnesburg na kasar Afirka ta Kudu, taron da zai mayar da hankali kan batutuwa da dama da suka shafi kasashen nahiyar.

results.title: Jami’an Italiya sun yi kokarin ceto jirgin ruwan Bakin haure
results.content: Jami’an kula da jiragen ruwa a kasar Italiya sun nasarar ceto wani jirgin ruwa da ya samu matsala a tsakiyar teku shake da bakin haure kimanin 450 bayan sun yi nasarar ceto rayuwan bakin haure da dama a cikin kwanaki biyu da suka gabata.

results.title: An samu ƙaruwar cin zarafin ɗan Adam da kaso 13% a Najeriya - HRW
results.content: Hukumar kare hakkin bil Adama a Najeriya ta Human Rights Commission, ta sanar da karuwar korafe korafen cin zarafi da tauye hakkin jama'a a ƙasar. A wani rahoto da hukumar ta fitar ta nuna cewa a watan Oktoba kaɗai ta samu korafe-korafe sama da dubu 384 kimanin kashi 13%.

results.title: Kotu ba ta amince da tsige shugaba Rajoanarimampianina ba
results.content: Kotun kolin kasar Madagascar ta yi watsi da matakin tsige shugaban kasar Hery Rajoana-rimampianina da majalisar dokokin kasar ta yi a ranar 26 ga watan jiya.

results.title: An sake zabar Netanyahu a matsayin shugaban Jam’iyya mai mulki
results.content: An sake zabar Fraiministan kasar Isra’ila Benjamin Netanyahu, a matsayin shugaban jam’iyyar Likud mai mulkin kasar, a wani zaben fitar da gwanin da aka yi jiya Alhamis. Zaben na zuwa ne a daidai lokacin da ake shirin yin wani zaben gaggawa a kasar, inda ya kayar da abokin takarar shi Danny Danon mai ra’ayin gurguzu.

results.title: Ƴanta'adda sun kashe hadimin gwamnan Zamfara a wani hari da suka kai Masallaci
results.content: Ƴanta'adda ɗauke da muggan makamai sun hallaka mataimaki na musamman ga gwamnan jihar Zamfara tare da yin garkuwa da mutane, a wani Masallacin da ke a Unguwar Low-cost ta Ƙaramar Hukumar Kaura Namoda.

results.title: Sarkozy ya soki kawance da ke fada da mayakan IS
results.content: Tsohon shugaban Faransa Nicolas Sarkozy ya yi kakkausar ga kawancen dakarun kasashen duniya a karkashin jagorancin Amurka, dangane da yadda ya kasa murkushe mayakan da ke da’awar jihadi a kasashen Syria da Iraki.

results.title: Masar ta buɗe ofishin jakadancin a Tripoli karo na farko cikin shekaru 12
results.content: Bayan shafe shekaru sha biyu ba tare da wakilcinta a babban birnin Libya ba, Masar ta sake buɗe ofishin jakadancinta a Tripoli, matakin da ke tabbatar da samun ɓaraka tsakaninta da Janar Khalifa Haftar, mai iko da yankin gabashin ƙasar ta Libya.

results.title: Hillary na gudanar da yakin neman zaben shugabancin Amurka
results.content: Tsohuwar sakatariyar harkokin wajen Amurka Hillary Clinton ta kaddamar da yakin neman zabenta na neman tsayawa takarar shugabancin Amurka a jiya asabar, inda ta ce tana fatar kasancewar mace ta farko da za ta jagoranci kasar a tarihi.

results.title: Ukraine ta kai farmaki da jirage marasa matuƙa 600 akan Moscow
results.content: Ukraine ta ƙaddamar da ɗaya daga cikin hare-haren jiragen yaƙi marasa matuƙa mafi girma akan Rasha tun bayan da ƙasashen biyu suka fara gwabza yaƙi, a cewar jami'an gwamnatin Rasha da rahotannin kafafen yaɗa labarai na ƙasashen waje a wannan Litinin.

results.title: RFI Hausa zai sauya Shafinsa na Intanet
results.content: Daga 15 ga watan Yuni, hausa.rfi.fr, shafin Intanet na RFI Hausa zai sauya sabuwar fuska, mai bayar da muhimmanci kan salon yada labarai irin na rediyo da hotunan bidiyo.

results.title: Ƴan tawayen Houthi sun matso kusa da shelkwatar gwamnatin Yemen
results.content: Dakarun ƴan tawayen Houthi sun matso kimanin kilomita 60 kusa da birnin Aden, babban birnin wucin-gadi na ƙasar Yemen.

results.title: Har yanzu yankuna da dama a Nijar na fuskantar ƙarancin man fetur
results.content: Yankuna da dama a Jamhuriyar Nijar na ci gaba da fuskantar ƙarancin man fetur, duk da matakan gaggawa da gwamnatin ƙasar ta ɗauka a watan Oktoban da ya gabata, domin ƙara samar da shi.

results.title: Kasashen EU 5 za su sanar da yarjejeniyar cibiyar jibge baƙin-haure a Rwanda
results.content: Ƙasashen Austria, Denmark, Jamus, Girka, da Netherlands na shirin sanar da wata sabuwar yarjejeniya da Rwanda a wannan Litinin, domin kafa cibiyar farko ta Tarayyar Turai ajiye baƙin haure a wajen nahiyar.

results.title: Najeriya: NDLEA ta kama dan ƙwallon kwando na Amurka da wiwi mai tarin yawa
results.content: Hukumar Yaƙi da Ta’ammali da Miyagun Kwayoyi ta Najeriya wato NDLEA ta kama wani ƙwararren ɗan wasan ƙwallon kwando ɗan ƙasar Amurka mai shekaru 28 bayan samun sa da kusan kilo 34 na wiwi, yayin da ta kama wani ɗan Najeriya da kusan kilo 25 na ƙwayar Methamphetamine a filin jirgin sama na Murtala Muhammad da ke Lagas.

results.title: Ƙasashe mambobin Francophonie na gudanar da taronsu a Cambodia
results.content: An fara taron Francophonie na ƙasashe masu amfani da harshen Faransanci, wanda ƙasar Cambodia ta soma karɓar baƙuncinsa a jiya Lahadi.

results.title: Sani Yahaya Janjouna kan taron ƙungiyar ƙasashen Francophonie
results.content: Yau liitinin an shiga rana ta biyu kuma ta ƙarshe a ci gaba da taron ƙungiyar Francophonie da ta ƙunshi ƙasashe fiye da 90 masu mu’amala da harshen Faransanci a duniya, taron da ke gudana a birnin Phnom Penh na ƙasar Cambodia. Sai dai taron na wannan karo ya zo ne a cikin wani yanayi na taƙaddamar neman shugabancin ƙungiyar tsakanin Jamhuriyar Dimokuraɗiyyar Congo da kuma Rwanda.

results.title: Gwamnan Lagos ta bai wa ƴan wasan Flamingos kyautar naira miliyan 10-10
results.content: Gwamnan jihar Lagos Babajide Sanwo-Olu, ya bai wa ƴan wasan tawagar Flamingos ta Najeriya da ta samu nasarar lashe kofin duniya na ƴan mata na ƙasa da shekaru 17 kyautar naira miliyan 10 kowaccensu tare da sabuwar waya ƙirar iPhone 17 Pro Max da dai sauran ƙyautuka.

results.title: Arsene Wenger ya ce ba zai nemi muƙamin shugaban FIFA ba
results.content: Tsohon mai horar da ƙungiyar ƙwallon ƙafa ta Arsenal, Arsène Wenger, ya tabbatar da cewa ba zai tsaya takarar shugabancin hukumar ƙwallon ƙafa ta duniya FIFA ba.

results.title: Ingila ta taka wa Spain birki 2-3 bayan wasanni 43 a jere ba a doke ta ba
results.content: Ingila ta ba da mamaki inda ta doke Spain da ci 3–2 a birnin Madrid a daren Lahadi, a wasan ƙarshe na matakin ruƙuni a gasar Nationsl League ta nahiyar Turai.
